english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person by or through whom a bet was made or accepted and having been required by the Gambling Commission to provide

(A)_[information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), ]_
(B)_[documents, namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENTS..), ]_
